Historical receipts do not contain enough identity information for a proven safe migration. Required next step: sanitized legacy identity mapping or an explicitly agreed compatibility policy, plus separate authorization for any migration outside the reviewed release sequence. Real provider acceptance remains open; In Review does not mean this defect is resolved.
